biotools.summary: This platform enables reference data-driven analysis of untargeted metabolomics data, contextualizing spectra through comparison to curated reference datasets. It provides a user-friendly web application and Python software package for analyzing metabolomics data, supporting visualization and statistical analysis.
biotools.name: GNPS Reference Data-Driven Metabolomics Platform
